invariants.rationale: The method always returns one of several new HoodieIndex instances or delegates to createUserDefinedIndex; it never returns null.
If indexClass is empty, the switch on indexType is used; otherwise, indexClass is used. In both code paths, at least one of these is true.
If indexClass is empty, indexType must be one of the handled types; otherwise, we use the custom index class.
If no user-defined index class is set, indexType must be one of the supported types; otherwise, any indexClass can be used.
If a user-defined index class is provided, config.getIndexType() is not used, but it's allowed for it to be null; when using indexType for switch, it must be non-null.
